buckets.name: Momentum Investing
buckets.rules: Monthly close at an all-time high after a cup of 2+ years; buy when price crosses that month's high. Stop: weekly close below the 30-week SMA, raised every week until it triggers.
buckets.test: US/ASX 2008-26: did not beat the index (paper phase).

buckets.name: Trend Following 9/21
buckets.rules: Same monthly breakout with a 1-2 year cup. Stop for sizing: EMA 21 (min 4% under the entry); exit when a daily close has EMA 9 below EMA 21 (sell next open).
buckets.test: Not tested on this market yet (paper record tracks it).

buckets.name: 9/21 Trend (any stock)
buckets.rules: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 on a stock in an uptrend; stop = 5-day low (max 12%); exit on Supertrend(10,3) red.
buckets.test: Off: in the full one-account test it adds about 1.7 points a year but deepens the worst fall from -21% to -28% (with Top Bottom: 36.2%, -23.3% vs 33.2%, -15.9%). Alone 20.7%/yr, -22.9%.

buckets.name: Breakout retest
buckets.rules: First return to an old breakout level; stop 1 ATR under it, 3R target, out after 120 days.
buckets.test: Off: +0.2R a trade on average, but as a 10-slot portfolio -1.3%/yr (the trades it can take cluster in falling markets).

buckets.name: Bottom pattern
buckets.rules: Double/triple bottom, tilted W, inverse H&S neckline breakout; stop under the pattern, measured-move target, 120 days.
buckets.test: Off: lagged the average stock in every industry lane (NSE 2017-26) and a random stock in the US/ASX test.

buckets.name: VCP
buckets.rules: Volatility contraction pattern in a Stage 2 uptrend: >= 2 shrinking pullbacks with higher lows, volume drying up; buy-stop above the last pullback's high on 1.4x volume; stop = that pullback's low (max 10%); sell after a daily close below EMA 50.
buckets.test: US 2008-26: +2.0% a trade (396 trades, 36% win); alone 8.5-8.9%/yr in 2017-26 vs the S&P 500 13.3%, weak 2008-16. Weaker than NSE - watch bucket, your call.

buckets.name: System 1
buckets.test: Off on NSE: below the Nifty in every version tested; a US paper candidate.

buckets.name: Wealth Creation
buckets.rules: ETF Pie funded by a monthly SIP, outside the systems' capital: Nifty 50, Midcap 150, Gold and US Nasdaq 100 ETFs at fixed weights (Equal, Balanced or Aggressive) rebalanced each quarter, or the monthly rotation (best 2 by 3-month return).
buckets.test: 2016-26 monthly, price indices, 0.2% per switch: Equal 25% each 18.3%/yr, worst -15.7%; Balanced 30/20/30/20 17.6%, -14.7%; Aggressive 30/30/10/30 18.4%, -20.2%; rotation 17.7%, -12.8%; Nifty 50 11.6%, -29.3%.
